makerspaces.name: NJIT Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Lists a 21,000 square foot facility with about $4 million of industrial and prototyping equipment; training is offered to NJIT community members.

makerspaces.name: FUBAR Labs

specialties.name: Biopharma manufacturing
specialties.note: A June 2026 industry op-ed describes New Jersey as a hub for aseptic manufacturing and cell and gene therapy production.

specialties.name: Medical technology manufacturing
specialties.note: The same industry group frames advanced manufacturing for biopharma and medical technologies as a state strength.

support.name: New Jersey Manufacturing Extension Program (NJMEP)
support.note: NIST MEP center offering lean, process improvement and workforce help to small and mid-sized manufacturers in all 21 counties.
